verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own trip and booking objects (Travel API lists trips; bookings carry policy data), automatic receipt matching to existing expenses, and a travel product that runs on the same platform as expense policies. That suggests trip spend lives alongside expenses, but nothing shows card charges, bookings and receipts automatically grouping into a single itinerary-linked report. Missing for 10: documented auto-grouping of card transactions by trip, an itinerary-linked expense report, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
